There's no Coenubia.\nWhere did it go...?
There is a white mistlike shadow.\nLooks like a Diel person but wispy...
Hey! Don't stop suddenly...
Hey! Don't stop suddenly...\nWhat? A wispy shadow...\nD-D-Don't say it's a g-ghost?!
H-Heh... Nothing is here.
You, human. You can see me, right? An ordinary\nperson wouldn't notice me like her... Hm, you have\na subtle scent of darkness... That makes sense.
Recently, a lot of unknown crystal monsters are\nlurking here... Don't go any further. Leave now.
H-Hey! What're you doing?!\nThere's nothing! Are you trying to scare me?!\nThat's too much!!
Noisy girl. Don't make things complicated...
Whoa? Wha... Whaaaaaaaaa!!
Ugh!
Sleep for a while...
Sleep for a while... Anyway, if you want to pass,\nbeat me. If I win, take that girl and go back.\nUnderstood?
Looks like there's no option but to fight...
Magnificent... I am Curonne Garan...\nBelieve or not, I used to be a president of\na republic.
I died long time ago, but I was worried about\nmy bereaved daughter. Dunkelis the Goddess of\nDarkness kindly allowed me to be here...
...I felt darkness from you, so I had to fight\neven knowing that you're not an evil person.\nForgive me for not introducing myself before this.
...Have you ever been to the Dark Domain?
You told her that Grecia the Goddess of Courage\nled you to the Dark Domain when you were critically\ninjured by an unknown monster...
What?! Grecia the Goddess?! How lucky you are!\nI assume that you can see ghosts since you were\nstaying at the Dark Domain...
Seems like you've got a strange power before\nyou notice...
Anyway, since Grecia the Goddess saved you,\nyou must be a reliable and special person...\nI think I can ask you this...
There is a town called Nov Saterica, a town of\nDiels. I want you to help out the elder of Diels,\nand the new Goddess of Justice. Her name is Kunon.
...Exactly. Kunon is my daughter...\nObligaus the former God of Justice left her to me\nand I raised her.
I'm so worried if she is guiding people as the\nnew goddess and leader of Diels... But she looks\nannoyed when I go to see her too often...
Ahem... Sorry, I'm cool now.\nKunon is trying to reconstruct the state of Diels,\nwhich nobody could achieve after the Cataclysm.
But she seems to have some trouble these days.\nI went to see her several times but she didn't\nwant me to help out...
Please! There would be few things that you can't\nresolve since you were recognized by Dunkelis and\nGrecia. Could you help out my daughter, Kunon?!
Oh, you'll do that?! I appreciate it!!\nDon't tell her that I asked you to help, please!
...Agh. Oh?
...Agh. Oh? I suddenly rolled on the ground...\nAnd I don't remember anything... What?!\nI was unconscious?! How did it happen...
Maybe I stumbled over something?\nBut I don't think so...
Well, right. It's no use staying at here.\nWhy not we go?
So, where are we going?\nNov Saterica?? I've never heard of such a town...
So, where are we going?\nNov Saterica?? I've never heard of such a town...\nYou've heard just now?
Where? From someone who passed by here while I was\nunconscious?! Wow, people other than us walk around\nsuch a place...
Don't! I said I'm scared of ghosts, didn't I?!\nW-We've gotta get outta here right now!!
